spec.description:
Proctor YouRippa Curing Tape is a heavy-duty, hand-tearable
polyethylene cloth protection and curing tape engineered for demanding jobsite
applications. Formulated with a natural rubber adhesive, it delivers strong,
residue-free adhesion to concrete, timber, metal, and floor protection sheets
during construction. Designed with an embossed backing for effortless straight
hand-tearing, it secures floor protection boards and concrete curing covers
without leaving sticky residue upon removal.
features:
Hand tearable in
both directions without cutting tools or scissors

Clean, residue-free removal
from sensitive finishes and cured concrete

Aggressive natural rubber adhesive
bonds firmly to multiple surfaces

Heavy-duty embossed polyethylene cloth
carrier resists tears and abrasion

Waterproof backing protects joins from
spills, foot traffic, and washdowns

Ideal for holding floor protection
boards, films, and concrete curing covers

High conformability around corners,
thresholds, and irregular profiles

Suitable for indoor and temporary outdoor
construction use

technical.value: Leaves no residue upon removal on approved substrates

spec.fire:
Standard
construction accessory rating; low hazard
install:
Ensure floor protection sheets, concrete, or
surfaces are clean, dry, and free of dust

Lay out floor protection boards or
curing covers with butted edges

Tear YouRippa tape by hand across the roll to
desired length
Center tape over the seam between protection sheets

Press
down firmly along the tape line to activate adhesive

Smooth down edges to
prevent tripping hazards during foot traffic

Peel tape cleanly away upon
project handover without leaving adhesive residue
selection_checklist:
Confirm requirement is temporary surface protection or concrete curing sheet
taping
Verify need for clean, residue-free removal from finished flooring
Calculate total lineal meters of floor protection seams

Ensure surface is
dry before application
limitations:
Temporary protection
tape; not designed for permanent building envelope weather-sealing

Do not
leave on sensitive timber finishes beyond recommended removal period

Not an
air-barrier or vapour-permeable membrane joining tape
spec.warranty:
Backed by
Proctor Group Australia product warranty

problem_keywords:
tape leaving sticky residue on
finished floors
slow taping needing scissors or knives
tape lifting under heavy foot traffic
use_cases:
Joining and
sealing temporary floor protection boards (corflute / hardboard) during building
construction

Securing concrete curing blankets and polyethylene sheets over
freshly poured concrete slabs

Temporary masking and edge protection of metal
window frames and stone sills during trades work
not_for:
Permanent
vapour-permeable building wrap sealing (use HighTack PLUS or DriFlash)
retrieval.rag_summary:
Proctor YouRippa Curing Tape is a heavy-duty, hand-tearable polyethylene cloth
tape designed for temporary surface protection and concrete curing applications
on construction sites. Coated with a natural rubber adhesive, it delivers high
grab to corflute, cardboard, timber, and cured concrete, yet removes cleanly
without leaving sticky residue. Hand-tearable in both directions for rapid
jobsite handling, it secures protective floor coverings against heavy trade
traffic.
